model.name: mvcBoundary.assertControllerDominates
model.description: Dominance LINT with TWO facets (one property, one home — architect ruling): (1) unitController.apply is the UNIQUE dominator of every unit mutation — no model.status= / no checklist-tick / no Done outside it, no hand-authored owned-view write; (2) status-string-writer family: deriveStatusEnum is the SOLE writer of the 4-state model.status strings — a literal 'QA Review'/'Done' status-set anywhere else -> RED. Two-bite each (plant a bypass -> RED; weaken the lint -> RED). Build-seq LAST (only true once the controller exists).
